title: クレーンゲーム大成功！

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I never imagined you'd win this many. You're very good at this.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: What do you think, everyone? How does the wind feel?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: You should all be very grateful to your savior.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: And so should I. Hehe. Thank you, Trainer.
